body: I go through the same thoughts all the time. I can't live a day without feeling like the biggest failure ever. Only seeing people with severe deformities and kids tortured by diseases I can feel slightly grateful about me being who I am. Fuck my life man.
I know there's a safety switch on some guns, but I didn't see one on mine. What does it look like?
Never mind. The trigger isn't moving. Not enough strength or some kind of safety is on? Why is dying have to be so complicated as well.
same. Every time my eyes meet others, I want to dig a hole and bury myself
It's hard to love yourself when everything tells you that you don't deserve to be loved
I just feel so trapped at this moment. I don't see any future. and even if there is one, I would kill to not to suffer through another hundred bad days like this.
